data.description:
Analyze the code-v3 code-review REVIEW_RESULT sidecar corpus (1760 sidecars / ~4284 findings, schema code_review_result_v2) to calibrate per-criterion block thresholds. Current criteria_routing.json blocks only on security (0.54, derived from the retired 114-sidecar code-v2 corpus by docs/experiments/derive_code_review_threshold.py) plus the two DET security detectors; every LLM criterion is advisory@0.95. 

Build a code-v3 calibrator (analog of docs/experiments/calibrate_plan_review_thresholds.py, segmented by impact_model_version=code-v3) reporting per criterion: n, fire-rate, mean validity, P(dropped), P(indeterminate), revision-response (criterion-load-delta across Gerrit revisions of the same change_id), surviving-priority percentiles, and worst verifier sub-question. Emit a precision-first per-criterion threshold proposal + a written report. Recommendations only; flipping any criterion to blocking on production requires operator sign-off (as the code-v2 derivation deferred security to sibling b9c0).
data.title: Calibrate code-review criteria thresholds against the code-v3 sidecar corpus
